blocks.text: Chordates bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic, deuterostome coelomates hain. Neeche di gayi chaar khasoosiyat sirf chordates mein hoti hain aur development ke kisi na kisi stage par zaroor maujood hoti hain.

items: Notochord: tamam chordates embryo ki zindagi mein notochord banate hain. Yeh vacuolated cells (khaali thailiyon wale cells) ki bani chhari jaisi, thori lachakdar (semi rigid) rod hai. Yeh gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan jism ki poori lambai mein hoti hai. Neeche darje ke (lower) chordates isey poori zindagi rakhte hain, jabke vertebrates mein development ke dauran yeh thori ya poori vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) se badal jati hai.

Pharyngeal slits: yeh pharynx ki side walls mein soorakhon ki ek qataar hain. Tamam chordates embryo mein jore-daar gill slits banate hain. Kuch chordates mein (jaise Amphioxus aur machhliyan) yeh gills ban jate hain. Kuch mein (jaise zyada tar amphibians) yeh zindagi ke kuch arse kaam karte hain. Baqi mein (jaise reptiles, birds aur mammals) yeh doosre kaamon ke liye badal jate hain.
Tubular nerve cord: tamam chordates mein ek nali jaisi (tubular) nerve cord jism ki lambai mein, notochord ke bilkul upar (dorsal) chalti hai. Aage ja kar yeh phail kar brain ban jati hai.

Post anal tail: tamam chordates mein ek dum (tail) banti hai jo anus se peeche tak jati hai. Kuch chordates isey poori zindagi rakhte hain, jabke doosron mein yeh embryo ki zindagi mein hi khatam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Lancelet jaisa chordate, pehlu se: peeth ke saath tubular nerve cord, us ke bilkul neeche poori lambai mein notochord, mouth ke baad pharynx jis mein pharyngeal gill slits hain, gut anus par khatam, aur anus se aage fin wali post-anal tail.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron khasoosiyat dhoondein: (1) peeli tubular nerve cord peeth (dorsal) ki taraf hai aur aage ja kar dimagh banti hai; (2) us ke neeche halka jamni notochord ek lachakdar (semi-rigid) rod hai; (3) laal pharynx mein safed tirchhi lakeerein pharyngeal gill slits hain, yani pharynx ki deewaron mein soorakh; (4) anus (chhota gol soorakh) ke baad jo hissa hai woh post-anal tail hai.
Phylum Chordata mein do bare groups hain: invertebrate chordates (reerh ki haddi ke baghair chordates) aur vertebrates.

items: Subphylum Urochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larvae mein hote hain. Sea squirts urochordates ki misaal hain.
Subphylum Cephalochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord poori zindagi rehta hai. Amphioxus ek aam cephalochordate hai.

blocks.alt: Gehre neele nali (tube) jaise sea squirts ka jhurmat; har ek ke upar halke kinare wala muh (siphon) hai. Yeh gulabi, narangi aur halke rang ke corals ke beech khare hain aur peeche gehri laal samandari ghaas (seaweed) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.18: Sea squirts (kitab ki Figure 1.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka)

blocks.alt: Amphioxus ka side view: patla, machhli jaisa jism jo dono siron par nokila hai; peeth aur dum par fin fold, V shakal ke muscle blocks, peeth ke saath notochord aur nerve cord, munh aur us ke cirri ke peeche lamba hara pharynx jis mein bohat si gill slits hain, aur dum ki taraf jati hui aant (gut).

items: Vertebrates: in mein vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) aur cranium (khopri) hota hai. Vertebrates saat classes mein baante gaye hain jo do groups mein rakhi gayi hain (agla topic).

items: Porifera: tissues nahi; ostia aur osculum; pinacocytes, mesohyle, choanocytes; spicules; gemmules.
Cnidaria: radial, diploblastic; nematocysts wale cnidocytes; sac-like gut; nerve net; polyp aur medusa.
Platyhelminthes: chapte, acoelomate (parenchyma); flame cells; cerebral ganglia; hermaphrodite.
Nematoda: gol, pseudocoelomate; tube-like gut; nerve ring; unisexual; Aschelminths ka numainda phylum.
Mollusca: head, visceral mass aur foot; mantle aur shell; radula; open circulation; nephridia.
Annelida: septa wale metameric segments; setae; metanephridia; haemoglobin ke saath closed circulation.
Arthropoda: jointed appendages, tagmata, chitin ka exoskeleton aur ecdysis; haemolymph; trachea; Malpighian tubules; compound eyes.
Echinodermata: baalig mein paanch ki radial symmetry; ossicles; madreporite aur tube feet wala water-vascular system; regeneration.
Chordata: notochord, pharyngeal slits, dorsal tubular nerve cord, post anal tail; Urochordata, Cephalochordata aur vertebrates.
